verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 3.4.1 give 9.95 x 10-4 S/cm at room temperature for the 0.05 Ca sample, with 0.23 eV activation energy, 1050 C / 7.30 h sintering, and 95.09% relative density for that sample. Measurement temperature is only given as 'room temperature', so null is appropriate.

Table 2 row for Ca x = 0 gives 6.61 x 10-4 S/cm and 0.25 eV, matching the record. The paper gives no numerical density for this sample, so null is correct, and the room-temperature Nyquist context supports the temperature.
Table 2 row for Ca x = 0.10 gives 4.07 x 10-4 S/cm and 0.32 eV, matching the record. Sintering conditions apply to the whole series and the room-temperature Nyquist context supports the temperature.
Table 2 row for Ca x = 0.15 gives 1.75 x 10-4 S/cm and 0.34 eV, matching the record. Sintering conditions apply to the whole series and the room-temperature Nyquist context supports the temperature.
Table 2 row for Ca x = 0.20 gives 5.72 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.36 eV, matching the record. Sintering conditions apply to the whole series and the room-temperature Nyquist context supports the temperature.
